name: Waterfiends

variantInfo.name: Waterfiend
notes: Waterfiends are level 115 demonic monsters with 128 Hitpoints and 128 Slayer XP.
They are found in the Ancient Cavern, Kraken Cove, and Iorwerth Dungeon.
They attack with Magic and magical Ranged; both attacks roll against the player's Magic Defence.
Their low crush Defence makes crush melee weapons the standard task-page recommendation.
The monster page lists a 100% elemental weakness to Earth spells and heavy ranged defence of 20.

locationComparison.name: Ancient Cavern
notes: Quickly accessed with a games necklace to Barbarian Assault.
Because the Waterfiend attack range is only 4 horizontal tiles, Ranged or Magic can safespot across the river.
The task page describes waiting out the 10 min aggression timer by running between the pillar safespot, the whirlpool landing platform, and back to the safespot.

locationComparison.name: Kraken Cove
notes: Quickly accessed with fairy ring AKQ.

locationComparison.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Quickly accessed with a teleport crystal and requires Song of the Elves.
Waterfiends in Iorwerth Dungeon can drop crystal shards, slightly increasing profit.
The task-page row marks this location cannonable but not safespottable.

taskNotes: Waterfiends can be assigned by Konar quo Maten and Duradel after 75 combat and access to the Ancient Cavern.
Access to the Ancient Cavern requires Barbarian Firemaking training up to being prompted to jump into the whirlpool for pyre ship bones.
Waterfiends attack with Magic and magical Ranged, so protection prayers cannot negate all incoming damage.
Both Waterfiend attacks roll against Magic Defence; Dragonhide armour, Karil's armour, Eclipse Moon armour, and a saturated or imbued heart can reduce damage.
Protect from Missiles is the most helpful protection prayer if they are dealing too much damage.
Eclipse Moon ranged armour is a strong defensive option because it adds Magic Defence while preserving Strength bonus.

Waterfiends have low crush Defence, so crush weapons such as abyssal bludgeon, Ursine chainmace, Sarachnis cudgel, zombie axe, leaf-bladed battleaxe, dragon mace, blisterwood flail, Ivandis flail, or keris partisan are recommended.
Waterfiends have a 100% elemental weakness to earth spells; earth magic is generally faster than melee but costs more.
Non-earth magic is not recommended because Waterfiends have high Magic level and magic Defence.
Bring High Level Alchemy runes for armour and staff drops.
The task page advises that Waterfiends are often worth a skip because they have moderately high stats, accurate attacks, and poor drops outside of Mist battlestaff for Ironmen.
Do not block Waterfiends in most cases; skip them instead because their assignment weight value of 2 makes them rare.
recommendedMethod: Use crush melee with high Magic Defence armour as the default low-cost method. Use earth magic when speed matters and rune cost is acceptable, or use Ranged gear defensively when wearing ranged armour for Magic Defence. Ancient Cavern supports Ranged/Magic safespotting across the river, Kraken Cove is task-only, and Iorwerth Dungeon supports cannoning plus crystal shard drops after Song of the Elves.
